race.description: Nijinsky Standing At Yirribee Stud Pace
race.comment: KEAYANG LADYBUG (5) has placed in her last two outings at this circuit and distance, last week beaten 3 metres in a higher-graded race. Draws wider but this looks a winnable assignment. DEADLINE (2) hasn't raced since June but produced some decent efforts last time in including a second at this circuit and distance two back. Draws well and has been readied with three trials. SPORTS LINER (1) is on the radar after he was competitive from this barrier here last time out. SHOOBEES SUNSET (9) might find this easier than the last attempt. Draws for a trail and did manage a second at Canberra two runs back.
